The Heritage & Heart

A Story of Love, Family & Sharing.

It all started around a warm dinner table. A devoted father would spend his weekends hand-rolling fresh sushi and frying warm tacos for his two growing children. Food wasn't just sustenance — it was his love language.

As the children grew up and moved away to pursue their dreams across different cities, every visit back home remained a sacred ritual. They would always bring back their father's favorite sushi rolls, gathering around that same dining table to reconnect.

Inspired by those cherished memories, SEP.9 was born in Pikesville, MD — a place where Japanese precision meets Mexican warmth, crafted so every guest feels like family returning home.
